newsitem.title: USA: East Coast heating oil stocks at 22.3 mln bbl -EIA.
newsitem.headline: East Coast heating oil stocks at 22.3 mln bbl -EIA.

text.p: Heating oil stocks on the U.S. East Coast climbed to 22.3 million barrels last week, up 900,000 barrels from the previous week, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration.
EIA called the gain promising amid an otherwise "serious" outlook for distillate supplies ahead of this winter.
Heating oil on the East Coast made up 57 percent of regional distillate stocks last week, up from 55 percent the previous week but weak compared to last year's 74 percent.
Distillate imports over the last four weeks averaged 190,000 bpd, slightly higher than last year, EIA said.
Distillate production averaged about 3.3 million barrels per day over the last four weeks, roughly on par with output over the same period last year.
Demand over the four weeks ran about about 3.1 million bpd, also about the same as last year, EIA said.
